mapper.select: SELECT ju.JOBSEEKER_NAME AS name, cp.KEYSKILL AS keySkill, cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE AS matchRate, cm.COM_AI_REASON AS reason, DATE_FORMAT(cm.MATCHING_CREATEAT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS matchDate, cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX AS jobPostsIdx, cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX AS jobseekerIdx, ca.COMPANY_APPLICANT_IDX AS companyApplicantIdx FROM company_matching cm JOIN jobseeker_users ju ON ju.JOBSEEKER_IDX = cm.JOBSEEKER_IDX JOIN company_applicant ca ON cm.COMPANY_APPLICANT_IDX = ca.COMPANY_APPLICANT_IDX JOIN cover_posts cp ON ca.COVER_POSTS_IDX = cp.COVER_POSTS_IDX WHERE cm.JOB_POSTS_IDX = #{jobPostsIdx} ORDER BY cm.COM_MATCH_SCORE DESC LIMIT 20
